description: This Java class demonstrates sharing content (specifically an image) from a private content provider within an Android application. It sets up a button that, when clicked, constructs a content URI pointing to a resource, and initiates a share intent with proper permissions.

classes.name: ShareContent
classes.description: An Android Activity that provides a UI to share image content via intent.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and assigns button click behavior.
